# Labour Cost Dashboard

A ready-made board in the Dashboards app (Human Resources section), installed
automatically with the Hourly Cost module.

## KPI cards
Total Cost, Overtime Cost, Night Supplement, Overtime Share (% of total cost),
Cost per Hour. Monetary cards show the change vs the previous period; rising
costs render red.

## Charts
Cost by Department, Overtime Cost by Department, Cost Trend, Weekly Cost by
Department.

## How to use
- Filters: Period, Department, Company. Amounts are in the company currency.
- Cost figures are visible to attendance managers only.
- Every figure links to the daily measurement rows behind it.
